channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Herb Simon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Herb Simon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kevin Pritchard, Herb Simon
item.description:
“My sincere thanks to Herb Simon, Kevin Pritchard and the entire Pacers organization for the opportunity to come back to basketball's heartland,”

Rick Carlisle on Kevin Pritchard, Herb Simon, Jun 24, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Herb Simon
item.description:
Scott Agness:Kevin Pritchard on his spending power:

“Herb (Simon) wants to win. We set a budget. It’s a very high budget, I’ll tell you that. Herb has never told me ’No' if it makes the team better. Not one time.”

Kevin Pritchard on Herb Simon, May 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Herb Simon
item.description:
“I'm very appreciative of Kevin and Mr. Simon (team owner, Herb Simon) for this show of faith in what we are doing,”

Nate McMillan on Herb Simon, Sep 4, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Herb Simon
item.description:
“I want to thank Larry, Herb Simon and the Pacers for this opportunity, which is a great opportunity,”

Nate McMillan on Herb Simon, May 16, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Herb Simon
item.description:
“I listen to everything. (Owner) Herb Simon and I have had this conversation before. So yes, if something presented itself, I would definitely look at it and go from there.”

Reggie Miller on Herb Simon, Sep 6, 2012. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: David Morway on Donnie Walsh, Herb Simon
item.description:
Morway said in a statement released by the team.

“After discussing all of these issues with our owner Herb Simon and (president) Larry (Bird), I believe this is the right time to step away. “I want to thank Mr. Simon, Larry, (former team president) Donnie Walsh and (president) Jim Morris for the opportunity they gave me and the friendship and mentorship they provided.”

David Morway on Donnie Walsh, Herb Simon, Jun 26, 2012. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Larry Bird on Herb Simon
item.description:
“I’ll sit down with Herbie (team owner Herb Simon) when it’s all done and we’ll move from there. Herbie will ask me about it every once in a while, but I don’t want to be a distraction. Right now, it’s the furthest thing from my mind.”

Larry Bird on Herb Simon, Apr 27, 2012. Source: Indianapolis Star.
